ApiKey.Name: LegendKeeper API Key
ApiKey.Hint: Project-scoped API key (starts with lk_...) generated in LegendKeeper under Project Settings → Developers → API Keys (Admin role recommended).

BaseUrl.Name: API Base URL / CORS Proxy
BaseUrl.Hint: URL of the CORS proxy forwarding browser requests to LegendKeeper's API. Defaults to a Cloudflare Worker proxy so it works from any network over HTTPS. You can also deploy your own Cloudflare Worker (tools/cloudflare-worker.js) or run the local proxy ('node tools/lk-cors-proxy.mjs' at http://localhost:8787).

ProjectId.Name: Project ID (Optional)
ProjectId.Hint: Leave blank to auto-detect from your API key, or specify a LegendKeeper Project ID explicitly.

RootFolderName.Name: Root Journal Folder Name
RootFolderName.Hint: Top-level Foundry Journal folder where synced LegendKeeper content is placed. Leave empty to place at the Journal root.

FolderMode.Name: Journal & Folder Organization Mode
FolderMode.Hint: Choose how LegendKeeper articles are organized in Foundry VTT. Switching modes and clicking 'Pull All from LK' automatically migrates and cleans up the previous layout.

Choices.singleFolder: Single Top-Level Folder + Wiki Index (One Journal per Article)
Choices.nestedFolders: Nested Folders (up to Foundry's 4-Level Limit) + Path Names Below + Wiki Index
Choices.singleJournal: Single Master Journal Entry (Entire Wiki as Pages Inside One Journal)

SecretHandling.Name: LegendKeeper Secret Handling
SecretHandling.Hint: How LegendKeeper secret blocks should be imported into Foundry Journal pages. Stripped secret blocks are preserved in LegendKeeper when pushing back.

Choices.secretBlock: Convert to Foundry <section class="secret"> blocks (GM-only revealable)
Choices.strip: Exclude / Strip secret blocks on pull (preserve in LK on push)

HiddenResourceHandling.Name: Hidden Resource & Document Handling
HiddenResourceHandling.Hint: Visible LegendKeeper resources are imported with All Players: Observer permission so players can view the wiki. Choose how resources or document tabs marked Hidden in LegendKeeper are imported:

Choices.gmOnly: Import Hidden items as GM-Only (All Players: None)
Choices.skip: Skip hidden resources and hidden document tabs completely
Choices.default: Import Hidden items as visible to players too (All Players: Observer)

ConflictPolicy.Name: Sync Conflict Policy
ConflictPolicy.Hint: Before any push or pull, the module checks whether both LegendKeeper and Foundry modified the exact same page since the last sync. Choose how same-page conflicts are resolved.

Choices.ask: Prompt with side-by-side preview to pick which version to keep or abandon sync (Recommended)
Choices.preferLK: Always keep LegendKeeper version on conflict
Choices.skip: Skip conflicting pages without overwriting either side

IncludeSidebarProperties.Name: Render Sidebar Properties & Tags in Journal
IncludeSidebarProperties.Hint: When enabled, a resource's LegendKeeper tags, aliases, banner image, and sidebar properties are rendered at the top of its primary Journal page (automatically stripped on push).

IncludeNavigationLinks.Name: Render Hierarchy Breadcrumbs & Child Links
IncludeNavigationLinks.Hint: When enabled, synced Journal entries include clickable @UUID breadcrumb links to their parent path and child resources at the top of the primary page (automatically stripped on push).

AutoSyncOnSave.Name: Auto-Push Linked Journals on Save
AutoSyncOnSave.Hint: When enabled, editing and saving a linked Journal Entry or Page in Foundry automatically checks LegendKeeper for remote edits/conflicts and pushes your changes.

UploadLocalImages.Name: Upload Local Images to LegendKeeper on Push
UploadLocalImages.Hint: When pushing Foundry journals to LegendKeeper, upload local/Foundry images as LegendKeeper image assets so they can be embedded in LK blocks.

Notifications.NoApiKey: LegendKeeper Sync: Please configure your LegendKeeper API Key in Module Settings.
Notifications.PullComplete: LegendKeeper Pull complete: {created} created, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped.
Notifications.PushComplete: LegendKeeper Push complete: {created} created, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped.
